note: World model from a real arm (data/robot). Four small runs share one L4: with/without motor commands, 2 seeds; then the decision test on the with-command runs.

cmds.world_s0: python3 robot_world.py --device cuda --threads 2 --B 32 --steps 6000 --minutes 45 --seed 0 --out runs/robot/gpu_world_s0 && python3 robot_plan.py --threads 2 --ckpt runs/robot/gpu_world_s0.pt --out runs/robot/gpu_plan_s0.json
cmds.world_s1: python3 robot_world.py --device cuda --threads 2 --B 32 --steps 6000 --minutes 45 --seed 1 --out runs/robot/gpu_world_s1 && python3 robot_plan.py --threads 2 --ckpt runs/robot/gpu_world_s1.pt --out runs/robot/gpu_plan_s1.json
